[NERR.15.1] **A failure does not stop a pump.** The pump runs its agenda to
exhaustion ([NLFC.2.2]) whatever fails along the way, and returns the first
non-OK result from any of: a fact-event listener; the TTL sweep; a rule's RHS
action verb (e.g. an essential verb with no callback); a typed callback; the
stream sink. Two statuses take precedence over that first one: the pump's own
refusal of the call, and `DS_ERR_ENGINE_HALTED` when an `EngineError` halts the
tier, which stops the pump at the fault ([NCBK.2.9]).
